summary: One VivaCity camera (C0000301) covers nine zones at Cliff Rd / Harbour St, Wollongong, from Jul 2023 to Aug 2026, with outages (Nov 2023, Dec 2023-Apr 2024, late May-Aug 2024) already set missing by zero_outage; Sunday mass-ride peaks (2024-04-21, 2024-11-03, 2025-04-27, 2026-04-19) are real. The Cliff Rd (SW) footpath zone (site 334) produced phantom counts, often overnight, from Oct 2023 to Nov 2024 and is set missing for that span, and a six-day daytime surge in Oct 2025 is left as uncertain. On 2024-11-29 the zone split changed abruptly (road zones down, crossings and some paths up, camera total similar), so nine directions are split into before/after series.
